groups.heading: Project & Services
groups.subheading: Common questions about how Smart Choice Contractors USA handles construction and remodeling projects.

items.q: What services does Smart Choice Contractors USA provide?
items.a: We provide residential and commercial construction services, remodeling, kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, roofing, electrical, plumbing, drywall, painting, repairs, additions, drawings, permit support, and project planning throughout Tampa Bay and surrounding Florida areas.

items.q: Do you work on both residential and commercial properties?
items.a: Yes. We work with homeowners, investors, property managers, commercial tenants, business owners, and property owners who need remodeling, repairs, buildouts, maintenance, or construction planning.

items.q: Do you provide free consultations?
items.a: We offer consultation options depending on the project type. Some projects can begin with a phone review, while others require an in-person visit, measurements, photos, drawings, or a paid consultation depending on complexity.

items.q: How long does a remodeling project usually take?
items.a: Project timelines depend on scope, permits, inspections, material availability, change orders, design decisions, hidden conditions, and local building department review. Small repairs may take days, while kitchens, bathrooms, additions, and full renovations may take weeks or months.

items.q: Can you help with project planning before construction starts?
items.a: Yes. We can help with project planning, site review, measurements, scope organization, material lists, construction drawings, permit preparation, and estimate development before work begins.

items.q: Can you create 3D renderings or walkthroughs?
items.a: Yes. For certain projects, we can help create 3D visuals, renderings, layout concepts, and project images to help owners understand the design before final decisions are made.

items.q: Do you provide material takeoffs and quantity estimates?
items.a: Yes. We can prepare material takeoffs and quantity estimates for flooring, drywall, paint, framing, roofing, tile, cabinets, trim, and other construction materials when the project scope and measurements are available.

items.q: Can you help with insurance-related repair projects?
items.a: We can assist with repair scopes, photos, estimates, and project documentation. Insurance claim approval, coverage, and payment decisions are handled by the insurance carrier and policy terms.

items.q: Do you provide emergency repair services?
items.a: Emergency availability depends on schedule, trade type, weather, location, and safety conditions. Electrical, plumbing, roofing, water damage, and storm-related repairs should be reviewed quickly to reduce additional damage.

items.q: How do I start a project with your company?
items.a: Start by contacting us through the website, booking an appointment, calling our office, or submitting a project form. Include the property address, photos, project description, budget range, and any drawings or permits you already have.

groups.heading: Permits, Codes & Florida Requirements
groups.subheading: Helpful questions about permits, inspections, Florida Building Code, and county requirements.

items.q: Do construction projects in Florida require permits?
items.a: Many projects require permits, especially electrical, plumbing, roofing, structural, mechanical, additions, window and door replacements, and major remodeling. The final requirement depends on the local building department and exact project scope.

items.q: What Florida Building Code edition applies now?
items.a: Florida currently uses the 8th Edition 2023 Florida Building Code for many current permit applications. Local jurisdictions may also have procedures, floodplain requirements, forms, and review requirements.

items.q: Who pulls the permit for the project?
items.a: As a Florida licensed contractor, Smart Choice Contractors USA pulls required permits for our contracted construction projects when permit support is included in the agreement.

items.q: How long does permit review take in Tampa Bay counties?
items.a: Permit turnaround times vary from a few days for simple trade permits to several weeks for structural plans, additions, or commercial reviews. Review speeds depend on county workload and plan completeness.

items.q: What happens during a building inspection?
items.a: Inspectors from the local building department visit the site at key milestones (rough-in, electrical, plumbing, insulation, framing, and final) to verify work conforms to approved plans and Florida building code.

groups.heading: Notice of Commencement (NOC) & Payments
groups.subheading: Important information regarding Florida lien law, Notice of Commencement recording, and payment terms.

items.q: What is a Florida Notice of Commencement (NOC)?
items.a: A Notice of Commencement is an official legal form recorded with the County Clerk of Court before starting construction projects exceeding $5,000 (or $15,000 for HVAC repairs). It establishes the official start date and protects property owners under Florida construction lien law.

items.q: Where is the Notice of Commencement recorded?
items.a: It must be recorded with the County Clerk of Court in the county where the property is located (e.g., Hillsborough, Pasco, Pinellas, Hernando, or Citrus County) and a certified copy must be posted at the jobsite before the first inspection.

items.q: What payment methods and milestones do you accept?
items.a: We accept checks, wire transfers, ACH, and major credit cards. Payment schedules are tied to clear project milestones (deposit, rough-in, progress stages, and final completion after punch list walkthrough).

items.q: Do you offer financing options for homeowners?
items.a: Yes! We work with multiple top home improvement lenders offering loans up to $100,000 with 0% promotional APR periods and flexible terms. Visit our Customer Financing page for instant pre-qualification.

groups.heading: Quality, Estimates & Project Closeout
groups.subheading: Details regarding our estimating accuracy, workmanship warranties, and final closeout.

items.q: What warranty do you provide on completed work?
items.a: Smart Choice Contractors USA provides a comprehensive 1-year workmanship warranty on remodeling and construction scopes, along with passing all manufacturer warranties on installed materials and equipment directly to you.

items.q: How do change orders work if I want to add something?
items.a: All scope adjustments, material upgrades, or unexpected hidden conditions are documented in writing with clear cost and timeline adjustments via an official Change Order before work proceeds.

items.q: What is included in the final project closeout?
items.a: Our closeout process includes a thorough final punch-list walkthrough, complete jobsite cleanup, passing all building department final inspections, and delivering manufacturer manuals, warranty packets, and lien releases.
